meta.title: Twelve Mice in the Garden
meta.textType: counting: numbers to twenty and plurals

paragraphs: Squeaky is a small mouse in the garden. One day, he finds a toy box. The box is open. He looks in the box. He sees a red plane. He sees a blue motorbike too. There is a toy monkey. "Squeak, squeak!" says Squeaky. Squeaky jumps on the motorbike. The motorbike goes on the grass. Squeaky is very happy.

Then Squeaky's friends come. One mouse, two mice, three mice! Squeaky counts his friends. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Ten mice are in the garden. Two more mice come. Now twelve mice are here. Six mice sit on the plane. Five mice sit on the motorbike. One mouse sits on the toy monkey. The mice are very funny.

Lily is at the window. "Tom, come here!" she says. "Look at the mice!" Tom looks at the garden. "How many mice can you see?" asks Lily. "I can see twelve!" says Tom. "Twelve mice and one toy monkey," says Lily. The children smile. "Let's not take the toys." The mice can play today. It is a fun day.
text.summary: Squeaky the mouse finds a toy box in the garden. Eleven friends come, and Lily and Tom count twelve mice.
